news.title: Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in debt as it pursues AI buildout
news.summary: Microsoft boasts a strong credit rating and has managed to maintain positive free cash flow, unlike Meta, Alphabet and Amazon.

news.title: Jim Cramer says Wall Street is punishing the wrong tech stocks
news.summary: Disappointing results from one company don't necessarily signal trouble for an entire industry.

news.title: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
news.summary: Amazon's cloud signed deals with Meta and OpenAI during the quarter, helping revenue to exceed consensus.

news.title: Reddit shares sink on weak sales guidance and plans login requirement test as Google search traffic shrinks
news.summary: Reddit posts third-quarter earnings and reveals plans to require all users to create official accounts as Google search traffic shrinks

news.title: Intel stock plunges 21% as chipmaker blames PC slowdown for weak guidance
news.summary: Intel has been a Wall Street darling this year due to its emergence as a player in AI, but the company is being weighed down by a struggling PC market.

news.title: Cramer sees opportunity amid tech turmoil and predicts a holiday win for FedEx
news.summary: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

news.title: Amazon posts negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion, holds 2026 capex unchanged
news.summary: Amazon's negative free cash flow ballooned during the third quarter, while its earnings and revenue fell short of Wall Street's expectations.

news.title: Nvidia responds to report Jensen Huang was target of Chinese asset, says diversion allegations were 'investigated and debunked'
news.summary: Nvidia disputed a New York Times report that U.S. intelligence agencies surveilled a person close to CEO Jensen Huang over concerns she could be a Chinese spy.

news.title: ServiceNow shares plunge 27% to worst day ever after earnings revive AI disruption fears
news.summary: ServiceNow's stock recorded its worst day ever on underwhelming third-quarter results.

news.title: Alphabet drags on Nasdaq futures as the stock faces a record post-earnings loss
news.summary: Concerns rise that the Google-parent is taking a hit from AI competition

news.title: AI buildout hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
news.summary: Microsoft and Alphabet both reported capital expenditures that fell short of estimates, adding to concern over the cost of the AI buildout.

news.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
news.summary: Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue out of the company's core business.

news.title: Alphabet tanks nearly 13% for worst day ever, losing $500 billion in value
news.summary: Alphabet reported a larger negative free cash flow than analysts had expected while maintaining its spending gudiance for the year.

news.title: U.S. worker job engagement hits lowest level since 2011, new Gallup poll finds
news.summary: Gallup finds U.S. worker engagement on the job sinking to a level not seen since 2011, with remote and hybrid employees and AI primary factors.

news.title: Samsung Electronics shares slid despite record profit in the third-quarter
news.summary: Samsung Electronics reported third-quarter earnings on Thursday.

news.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
news.summary: Microsoft reported better-than-expected results driven by 48% growth in Azure revenue.

news.title: Amazon Shares Drop After Spending Soars, Online Business Slows
news.summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares dropped after the company reported greater capital spending than anticipated and the slowest growth in the core e-commerce business in three years.

news.title: Binance Founder Says Possible Hack of Exchange; Bitcoin Falls
news.summary: Binance, the world’s largest crypto exchange, suspended all deposits and withdrawals as it investigates a security incident that has so far resulted in the freezing of more than $2.5 billion in assets. The suspected hack sent digital tokens tumbling.

news.title: Nvidia in Talks to Offer Credit Support for Nscale Project
news.summary: Nvidia Corp. is in discussions to provide credit guarantees for an Nscale data center facility that Anthropic PBC plans to use, according to a person familiar with the matter.

news.title: 29-Year-Old Female Founder Breaths Life Into Next Generation Home-Help Robots
news.summary: Dreame’s Huo is working on artificial intelligence algorithms and humanoid machines to handle cleaning, washing and other chores.

news.title: Roblox Shares Fall After Company Reports Daily User Decline
news.summary: Roblox Corp. reported a year-over-year decline in player engagement after deploying more robust child-safety measures.

news.title: Apple’s iPhone Maker Confident of Meeting Surge in Duo Demand
news.summary: Apple Inc.’s main assembly partner Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. expects its expansive global manufacturing presence will help it fulfill growing demand for the US company’s marquee foldable device.

news.title: Intel Plunges After PC Slump and Supply Snags Hurt Outlook
news.summary: Intel Corp. plunged in late trading after its revenue forecast missed analysts’ estimates, hurt by sputtering demand for PC processors and supply-chain problems with its lucrative data center components.

news.title: Reddit Sinks on Plan to Limit Access, Sales Outlook Miss
news.summary: Reddit Inc. is planning to limit access to its online forums in a bid to get users to register for accounts and deepen engagement, igniting investors’ concerns that the move will instead weigh on traffic while the company is already dealing with a dropoff in active US users.

news.title: AI Slowdown Is More Macro Than Tied to One Company: T.Rowe Price’s Wang
news.summary: Tony Wang, Portfolio Manager at T.Rowe Price, says investors are looking for AI-related spending to translate into better-than-expected revenue across companies’ core businesses and cloud operations, while also improving margins. He describes demand for AI chips as unprecedented, but warns that rapid shipments can strain supply chains and create bottlenecks, raising execution expectations. He spea...

news.title: GE Healthcare CEO on 3Q Earnings Beat, Impact of AI
news.summary: Peter Arduini, CEO of GE Healthcare, described radiopharmaceuticals as a fast-growing field that is advancing treatment and care in cancer, cardiology imaging and neurology, including Alzheimer’s-related approaches. Because these products have short half-lives and can dissipate by the end of the day, he said control of manufacturing and the supply chain is especially important. He speaks with Roma...

news.title: Raymond James CEO on 4Q Earnings and AI Strategy
news.summary: Raymond James shares rose after the company beat estimates for fourth-quarter revenue and adjusted EPS, with investment banking revenue also exceeding expectations. CEO Paul Shoukry said Raymond James focuses on sustainable growth and long-term decisions, noting 155 consecutive profitable quarters. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Tradeweb CEO: This Is a Seminal Moment in the Market
news.summary: Tradeweb shares were slightly lower after the company reported third-quarter results, with revenue in line with expectations and earnings beating them. CEO Billy Hult said on the earnings call that growth was broad-based, citing preliminary strong double-digit growth across rates, credit and equities. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Microsoft $25 Billion Blowout Bond Puts It in AI Winners’ Circle
news.summary: Microsoft Corp.’s mega $25 billion bond offering got a red-carpet reception. That doesn’t mean investors will be as welcoming when the next Big Tech borrower comes along.

news.title: Supply Constraints a Swing Factor for Intel, Seaport's Goldberg Says
news.summary: Jay Goldberg, Seaport Research Partners semiconductors and electronics senior analyst, reacts to Intel's revenue forecast missing analysts' estimates due to sputtering demand for PC processors and supply-chain problems. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Sandisk Posts Strong Profit, Upbeat Outlook on Growing AI Demand
news.summary: Sandisk Corp. posted stronger-than-expected results and guidance as the data center buildout drove demand and a memory supply crunch kept prices elevated.

news.title: Stryker Cuts Outlook as Cyberattack Impact on Supply Lingers
news.summary: Stryker Corp. slashed its outlook as the medical device company struggles to shake off the lingering effects of a cyberattack in March that disrupted manufacturing operations.

news.title: Polymarket Trading Halted After Reports of Stolen Funds
news.summary: Polymarket stopped trading on its international exchange on Thursday after it said that a third-party software provider was compromised.

news.title: Alphabet Plunges by Record With AI Exposure Topping $1 Trillion
news.summary: Alphabet Inc. has said demand for its cloud services is increasing at a rapid clip, pointing to growth in its backlog of cloud contracts that it hasn’t yet fulfilled. However, more than a third of that quarterly growth comes from a joint venture the company partly owns.

news.title: No One Wanted These Amazon Earnings, Thill Says
news.summary: Brent Thill, Jefferies software and internet research tech sector lead, says Amazon's earnings were not terrible, and the stock is cheap, but he says "this is not what anyone was hoping for." Spending on property and equipment was more than expected. Thill says there's been a lot of bad news from tech earnings this week. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Breaking Down Amazon's Third-Quarter Earnings
news.summary: Amazon spent more than $77 billion on property and equipment in the third quarter, far more than analysts’ estimates, while pursuing its effort to build data centers and fulfill demand for AI services. Anurag Rana and Poonam Goyal break down the numbers on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
news.summary: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

news.title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’
news.summary: The success of blockbuster hits like Project Hail Mary and Verity is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.

news.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
news.summary: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

news.title: Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto
news.summary: Some estimates say hackers stole billions in crypto from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, during a cyberattack on Thursday.

news.title: Elon Musk is ‘truly a genius,’ says Vladimir Putin
news.summary: Putin said that he and Musk are in "close contact" about Rassvet, Russia's Starlink-like satellite connectivity project.

news.title: Amazon reported booming cloud revenue but otherwise missed expectations
news.summary: The biggest ouch of the report was its negative free cash flow of $2.4 billion.

news.summary: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.

news.title: Fan-fiction site Archive of Our Own could be offline for up to 4 weeks
news.summary: The site has such a passionate user base that, within two hours of the announcement, its status page's posts had garnered millions of views (and much panicked commentary) across social media.

news.summary: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

news.title: The R2 SUV is already Rivian’s best-selling vehicle

news.title: Where was my invite to the — wait, what? Airbnb had a gala?

news.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
news.summary: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

news.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
news.summary: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

news.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
news.summary: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

news.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
news.summary: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

news.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
news.summary: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

news.title: SuperMe raises $20M for its network of AI expert profiles
news.summary: SuperMe is a network of AI profiles built from the knowledge of real-life experts. When you ask a question, the platform determines which experts are best suited to answer and creates a group chat with their AI profiles.

news.title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
news.summary: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain and Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents.

news.summary: Curry Barker, the director behind the hit horror film Obsession, just published a new horror short on YouTube. The short, titled "Mama Bear," is nearly five minutes long. news.summary: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said in an earnings call today that Google's AI-powered search modes do not help with traffic to the platform, echoing problems facing other websites and publishers. news.summary: Patrick Stewart, best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, has died at age 86. news.summary: With its playful design, versatility, and relatively affordable price, the Ikea Varmblixt quickly became one of my colleague Jennifer Pattison Tuohy’s new favorite smart light products when she tested it in April.
